name: Consumed by Hatred
summary: At the Crossroads, Mankrik turns his grief into a campaign against the Bristleback quilboar. Separated from his wife in a violent ambush, the orc calls on Horde travelers to kill the creatures and bring back their tusks.

sections.title: A Husband's Vengeance
sections.body: Mankrik still bears the grief of the quilboar ambush that battered him and left his wife missing. At the Crossroads, he looks toward the arid horizon and thirsts for Bristleback blood, though he has killed many himself. Now he calls on fellow Horde travelers to help him carry on the fight.

sections.title: Tusks of the Bristleback
sections.body: Mankrik demands sixty Bristleback quilboar tusks. Each one marks suffering returned to the creatures that tore his life apart. The trophies cannot heal his grief or end his desire for revenge. Yet seeing the Bristlebacks bleed brings the wounded warrior a fleeting, bitter satisfaction.

faq.q: Why does Mankrik want sixty quilboar tusks?
faq.answer: Grief and anger drive Mankrik to seek sixty tusks after a quilboar ambush separated him from his wife. The tally means heavy losses for the Bristlebacks, and their suffering gives him a little solace.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: Mankrik asks for the tusks at the Crossroads in the central Barrens. Bristleback quilboar live in nearby scrublands and thorned redoubts.

faq.q: Does turning in the tusks satisfy Mankrik's revenge?
faq.answer: No. Mankrik still wants revenge, though the quilboar's losses bring a grim smile and make him feel they have finally known his pain.

faq.q: Why does Mankrik mention Camp Taurajo?
faq.answer: Mankrik wonders whether fleeing south toward Camp Taurajo, instead of north to the Crossroads, after the ambush might have changed the battle's outcome and his search.

The Bristlebacks are an aggressive quilboar tribe native to the Barrens. Intensely territorial and distrustful of outsiders, they clash constantly with the Horde and attack travelers from thorn-choked encampments across the plains.

faq.q: Is this connected to finding Mankrik's wife?
faq.answer: Yes. Mankrik's hatred began with the ambush that overwhelmed him and his wife. As you search the plains for her fate in Lost in Battle, his demand for tusks calls for revenge against her attackers.

angles.text: As an orc, you may know Mankrik's grief and his drive to avenge fallen kin through orcish honor and the hard work of making a home in Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you face quilboar threats along travel routes between Durotar, Mulgore, and the southern Barrens. Mankrik's fight also protects Horde territory.
As a warrior, you know a wound to the heart cannot always be bandaged. Mankrik seeks his remedy with steel against steel across the thorned plains.
